structured_facts: Vantage and Heron announced a strategic manufacturing-capacity agreement.
Vantage says it secured more than 1 GW of manufacturing capacity for Heron Link solid-state transformers intended for hyperscale data-center campuses.
The release does not identify a commissioned campus, units delivered, acceptance-test records, operating hours, price or independently measured field performance.
Heron's separate factory announcement says mass production is planned for late 2027, so reserved capacity is not current produced output.
